answer: Each challenge is derived after a participant commits, by hashing that commitment with a specified future drand quicknet pulse. The threshold BLS signature makes the pulse unpredictable before release and publicly verifiable afterward, so a swarm cannot precompute answers to known prompts or farm them offline. It must perform work on each live, beacon-bound task; meadow, nebula, and willow can name distinct challenge domains without granting identities extra weight.
